data.name: Terra: The Voracious
data.detailed_description:
===============================================================================================

GAME DESCRIPTION:

"Terra: The Voracious" is a Furry-Vore RPG, using simple turn-based combat against various characters' stomachs, pouches, etc. Equip and Use a variety of Weapons, Armors, Equipment, Special Equipment, Items, and much more to defeat the predators in all of the Mainlands! Encounter over 30+ characters, both original characters and guest characters (OCs and GOCs), all in various areas in-game. Discover different game mechanics, dialogue, shops, quests, and some story/lore for characters inside of the "Terra" game series.

Will you be able to beat and escape all of the predators' stomachs, or will you only add to their body?

===============================================================================================

GAME INTRODUCTION:

After a long day at work, your childhood best friend "Terranious" invites you over to his hometown to "hang out" and meet up. Little do you know, this would lead to a long and squirmful journey across the state, encountering characters and escaping their guts!

===============================================================================================

DEVELOPER NOTE:

Heyo! I am Terranious Rivers, the Game Designer and Digital Artist!

I would like to thank you for checking out my game, and a bigger thank you for the supporters that have helped me up to this point. This game started in 3/22/25 as a small project and idea, my first actual game up for show and playing. I had low expectations for the game, being aimed at such a small target audience; I never thought I'd get this far, ever! Overnight, the game had gotten around 450 views, slowly increasing to 1K views, then 25K, and finally 80K! Once again, I have nobody else to thank but every single one of you! I promise, update by update, to improve and complete this game the most I can!

Have fun and fill some guts, preythings!

===============================================================================================
